items.title: India to Consider Equity Gains Tax Concerns, Sitharaman Says
items.description: India’s Finance Minister  Nirmala Sitharaman said she’ll consider tax changes on stocks as a prolonged equity-market slump intensifies pressure on policymakers to revive investor confidence.

items.description: Goldman Sachs Chief Executive Officer David Solomon says a technology supercycle will dominate capital markets and financing activity as deal demand remains robust. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Solomon on Tech Supercycle 'Bumps'
items.description: Goldman’s David Solomon said there will be “bumps” during this technology supercycle, while praising the US economy as resilient. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Copper, Tin Fall With Base Metals on Renewed AI Stocks Selloff
items.description: Copper and tin fell with other industrial metals, as a renewed selloff in technology stocks in Asia weakened the demand outlook for materials used in data centers and to solder circuit boards.

items.title: Reliance’s Record $19 Billion Surge Lifts Nifty, Keeps India Bulls in the Game
items.description: Reliance’s more than $19 billion surge in market value marks the biggest single-day gain for any Indian company.

items.title: China's He Lifeng on Hong Kong's Financial Edge
items.description: China's Vice Premier He Lifeng urges Hong Kong to utilize its One Country, Two Systems governance model to foster openness to global trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: China Vows to Boost Yuan Liquidity, Back Hong Kong Markets
items.description: China Vice Premier He Lifeng said China will continue to support a free and open economic environment in Hong Kong and boost offshore yuan liquidity in the financial hub.

items.title: Onshore Yuan Snaps Winning Streak as PBOC Lifts FX Reserve Ratio
items.description: The onshore yuan ended its longest winning streak in three decades after the People’s Bank of China moved to cool its rally by asking banks to hold more foreign currencies in reserve.

items.title: Pakistan’s Rebound Masks Deeper Problems Weighing on Economy
items.description: Pakistan’s soaring stock market, record foreign reserves and improving credit ratings are signaling an economy on the mend. Beneath the surface, the recovery remains far less convincing.

items.title: Gold Holds Biggest Jump in Two Months on Iran Peace-Deal Hopes
items.description: Gold was steady, after jumping the most in two months on Monday as hopes of a breakthrough in US-Iran peace talks sent oil prices plunging and eased anxiety over accelerating inflation.

items.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 3
items.description: Brent oil steadied after plunging almost 8% in the previous session, with the US and Iran signaling a willingness to pursue peace talks as the war in the Middle East enters its ninth month.

items.title: Asian Stocks Fall on US Tech Jitters, Yuan Weakens: Markets Wrap
items.description: Asian stocks fell after a selloff in US chipmakers deepened, overshadowing a plunge in oil prices driven by optimism over progress toward ending the war in Iran. The yuan weakened.

items.title: China’s Revival of 2024 Stock Rescue Tools Faces Skepticism
items.description: China is reviving the tools it deployed during the 2024 stock selloff, a playbook that market participants say may stem a further rout but fall short of reigniting equity gains.

items.description: A selloff in chipmakers weighed on stocks, offsetting a slump in oil prices driven by hopes for diplomatic efforts to end the war in Iran.
